label: AB3_oP16_62_c_cd-001
title: Cementite (Fe$_{3}$C, $D0_{11}$) Structure
comments:
\href{current_web_home_dir/AB3_oP16_62_c_cd-001}{Cementite ($D0_{11}$, Fe$_{3}$C)} and \href{current_web_home_dir/AB3_oP16_62_c_cd-005}{orthorhombic ClF$_{3}$} share the same AFLOW prototype label, AB3\_oP16\_oP16\_c\_cd. They are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files. 
 In addition, the ICSD places \href{current_web_home_dir/A3B_oP16_62_cd_c-001}{$\epsilon$-Al$_{3}$Ni ($D0_{20}$)} in the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB3_oP16_62_c_cd-001}{Fe$_{3}$C ($D0_{11}$)} structure type.  While both structures are in the same space group and have the same occupied Wyckoff positions, the lattice constants are very different, so split these compounds into two classes.  In any case the different {\em Strukturbericht} entries require two entries in the Encyclopedia.
